svg.title: Build pipeline
svg.desc: Build pipeline. Step 1: pdfLaTeX reads main.tex and writes notes about labels, headings, and the citations it needs. Step 2: Biber reads that citation list and references.bib and writes a formatted reference list. Step 3: pdfLaTeX runs again and places the references. Step 4: pdfLaTeX runs once more so page numbers in the contents and cross-references settle. The result is main.pdf.
